governance: CANDIDATES ONLY — discovery is not trust. No row here is an active capability; each must pass the seeder's gap/lift screen, then human/eval gates, before any promotion. Source URLs are as reported and were spot-verified via WebFetch where noted; license/verify_note flags carried verbatim. serves_truth=false for everything downstream.

candidates.intent: Send a Gmail message with subject, body, recipients, CC/BCC, and attachments via authenticated Gmail API.
candidates.output_contract: sent message id and delivery confirmation
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare LLM cannot authenticate to a mailbox or actually transmit a message over the Gmail API.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds OAuth2-authenticated Gmail API send with attachments, HTML, and multipart support.
candidates.verify_note: License MIT confirmed via WebFetch; supports send/draft/search/labels/attachments/batch.

candidates.intent: Search a Gmail mailbox with Gmail query syntax and retrieve full message content by id.
candidates.input_contract: Gmail search query or message id
candidates.output_contract: matching messages with headers, body, and attachment metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model has no access to a live inbox and cannot resolve real message ids or current contents.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authenticated Gmail search with advanced query syntax returning real message records.
candidates.verify_note: Confirmed via WebFetch: search by subject/sender/date plus advanced Gmail syntax.

candidates.intent: Create/list/update/delete Gmail labels and batch-modify or batch-delete up to 50 messages.
candidates.input_contract: label spec or batch of message ids plus action
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Mailbox organization is stateful and cannot be performed by a model without API access.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic label management and chunked batch operations over the Gmail API.
candidates.verify_note: Confirmed via WebFetch; batch capped at 50/op with automatic chunking.

candidates.intent: Download attachments from a Gmail message to local storage.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot fetch or persist a binary attachment from a remote mailbox.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authenticated attachment retrieval and local download with filename/type/size metadata.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo listing; focuses on search/read/attachment download.

candidates.intent: Send transactional email (HTML/text, CC/BCC, attachments, reply-to, scheduling, tags) via the Resend API.
candidates.input_contract: from, to, subject, body, optional schedule/tags
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate to an email provider or guarantee deliverable transactional sends.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the official Resend API with batch send, scheduling, tags, and topic-based sending.
candidates.verify_note: Official vendor server; MIT confirmed via WebFetch (10 tool groups).

candidates.intent: Create, schedule, and send Resend broadcast campaigns with personalization and preview text.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Campaign orchestration with audiences and scheduling is stateful infrastructure a model lacks.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds official broadcast create/send/schedule with personalization placeholders.
candidates.verify_note: Confirmed via WebFetch as one of the 10 official Resend tool groups.

candidates.intent: Create/list/update/remove Resend contacts, segments, and subscription topics.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Audience state lives in the provider and cannot be managed by a model directly.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic contact, segment, topic, and custom-property management.
candidates.verify_note: Confirmed via WebFetch (contacts/segments/topics/contact-properties tool groups).

candidates.intent: Create, verify, and configure Resend sender domains with tracking and TLS options.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Domain/DNS verification is an external stateful operation outside a model's reach.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds official domain create/verify with tracking and TLS configuration.
candidates.verify_note: Confirmed via WebFetch (domains tool group).

candidates.intent: Send email and retrieve/resend stored messages via the Mailgun API.
candidates.input_contract: from, to, subject, body, optional attachments
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot transmit email or persist/retrieve stored messages without provider access.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the official Mailgun API (50+ ops) for send, stored-message retrieval, and resend.
candidates.verify_note: Official vendor server; Apache-2.0 confirmed via WebFetch; API key isolated from the model.

candidates.intent: Query Mailgun sending metrics, logs, suppressions, and bounce classifications.
candidates.output_contract: delivery stats, suppression lists, bounce types
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Live deliverability metrics and suppression state are account-specific and absent from model weights.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic analytics, stats, suppression access, and bounce classification.
candidates.verify_note: Confirmed via WebFetch (analytics/stats/suppressions/bounce-classification areas).

candidates.intent: View and update Mailgun inbound email routing rules and event webhooks.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Inbound routing and webhook configuration are stateful provider settings a model cannot change.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic route and event-webhook management over the Mailgun API.
candidates.verify_note: Confirmed via WebFetch (routes/webhooks areas).

candidates.intent: Send and manage transactional/marketing email via Mailjet's API as MCP tools.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate to Mailjet or transmit campaigns/transactional mail itself.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an official Mailjet API wrapper exposing send and management as MCP tools.
candidates.verify_note: Vendor-org repo (Mailgun org maintains Mailjet server); license inferred Apache-2.0 from sibling repo — confirm before relying.

candidates.intent: Send single/transactional email and manage dynamic templates via the Twilio SendGrid v3 API.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate to SendGrid or render/transmit a dynamic-template send.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds SendGrid v3 API access for single sends, contact lists, templates, and stats.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo listing; widely referenced community SendGrid server.

candidates.intent: Pull SendGrid email statistics and manage contact lists and templates.
candidates.output_contract: email metrics, list, or template records
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Account-specific email stats and stored templates are not in model weights.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds live SendGrid stats pulls and HTML-template management for marketing teams.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; Flask/Python implementation.

candidates.intent: Read, search, send, and draft email across any IMAP/SMTP provider (Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo/iCloud/etc).
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Provider-agnostic mailbox access, threading, and transport are stateful and outside a model's reach.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds generic IMAP/SMTP send/read with automatic save-to-Sent on the IMAP server.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo listing; explicitly IMAP+SMTP via MCP.

candidates.intent: Unified email access across Gmail (REST), Outlook (Graph), iCloud (IMAP), and generic IMAP/SMTP.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Each provider has distinct auth/APIs a model cannot reconcile or call on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a single interface over Gmail/Outlook/iCloud/IMAP with OAuth2 and encrypted credential storage.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; multi-provider unification claim per repo description.

candidates.intent: Read IMAP email and create draft replies (built for ProtonMail Bridge).
candidates.output_contract: message content and a created draft reply
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot connect to an IMAP server or persist a draft reply itself.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds lightweight IMAP read plus deterministic draft-reply creation.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; targets ProtonMail Bridge.

candidates.intent: Read, search, send, and reply to Outlook/Microsoft 365 email and download attachments via Microsoft Graph.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate via MSAL or operate a Microsoft 365 mailbox over Graph.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds MSAL-authenticated Graph email ops (200+ tools incl. mail) with read-only mode option.
candidates.verify_note: MIT confirmed via WebFetch; 200+ Graph tools across mail/calendar/Teams/OneDrive.

candidates.intent: Operate a personal Outlook account (mail/calendar/contacts/tasks/drafts/attachments) via Microsoft Graph.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Personal-account mailbox state and auth are outside a model's capabilities.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds 54 Graph tools across 13 categories for personal Outlook mail and calendar.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; community project, explicitly not affiliated with Microsoft.

candidates.intent: Post a message to a Slack channel and reply within threads.
candidates.input_contract: channel id and message text (optional thread ts)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate to a Slack workspace or transmit a message to a channel.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the maintained successor to Anthropic's reference Slack server with 8 messaging ops.
candidates.verify_note: Formerly the modelcontextprotocol reference Slack server, now maintained by Zencoder; license not confirmed on listing.

candidates.intent: Retrieve Slack channel history and thread replies, list channels, and read user profiles.
candidates.output_contract: message history, thread replies, channel/user records
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Workspace history and roster are live, private state absent from model weights.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic channel-history, thread, channel-list, and user-profile retrieval.
candidates.verify_note: Eight operations incl. get_channel_history/get_thread_replies/list_users; license unconfirmed.

candidates.intent: Read, search, and post Slack messages in OAuth or permission-less stealth mode with DM/Group-DM support.
candidates.output_contract: messages, search hits, or post status
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reach Slack DMs/Group-DMs or run searches without an authenticated client.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds rich Slack read/search/post (DMs, smart history pagination, Stdio/SSE) with safety-gated posting.
candidates.verify_note: MIT confirmed via search; posting disabled by default (SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_TOOL).

candidates.intent: Use Slack as the chat front-end that bridges users to MCP servers via a bot.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model has no Slack event loop or bot identity to receive and answer messages.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a Slack bot + MCP client bridge so LLMs converse and call tools from Slack.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; this is a client/bridge, not a tool server — categorize accordingly.

candidates.intent: Send and read messages in Discord channels through Discord's API.
candidates.input_contract: server id, channel id, message content
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate a Discord bot or transmit channel messages itself.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds bot-authenticated send/read with an approval prompt before any send.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; asks for approval before sending.

candidates.intent: Send Discord messages with embeds, replies, and TTS, and stream real-time Discord events to the client.
candidates.output_contract: send status plus streamed event notifications
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Rich embeds and live event streams require a stateful gateway connection a model lacks.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds embeds/replies/TTS plus JSON-RPC real-time event streaming from Discord.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; full Discord API surface plus event stream.

candidates.intent: Send a notification message to a Discord channel/webhook for alerts.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot emit an outbound webhook/notification on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a minimal deterministic Discord notification sender.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; notification-only scope.

candidates.intent: Read, create, and reply to Microsoft Teams messages and mention members via Graph.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate to Teams/Graph or post into channels with mentions.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds read/create/reply/mention operations over the Microsoft Teams API.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo listing; enterprise-authored (Inditex).

candidates.intent: Comprehensive Microsoft Teams + Graph messaging, search, and user management for AI assistants.
candidates.input_contract: OAuth device-code auth plus message/search query
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Teams content and roster are private live state behind Graph auth a model cannot reach.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds OAuth2 device-code Graph access with sanitized markdown-to-HTML message sending.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; markdown sanitized before send.

candidates.intent: Send a notification message to Microsoft Teams (Markdown-formatted).
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot emit an outbound Teams notification on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a minimal deterministic Teams notification tool with Markdown support.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; single send-notification tool.

candidates.intent: Drive the full Telegram Bot API (send messages/media, manage updates) from an LLM.
candidates.input_contract: bot token and Telegram Bot API call
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot hold a Telegram bot token or call the Bot API endpoints itself.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds comprehensive type-safe Telegram Bot API coverage as MCP tools.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; broad Bot API surface.

candidates.intent: Send Telegram messages, photos, documents, and videos via a bot for notifications.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot transmit media or messages over the Telegram Bot API on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic Telegram message/photo/document/video sending.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; notification-oriented.

candidates.intent: Ask a user a question over Telegram and receive their reply back into the agent.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model has no channel to reach a human asynchronously and collect a reply.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a human-in-the-loop ask/answer round-trip over a Telegram bot.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; transport is deterministic, the answer content is human.

candidates.intent: Send WhatsApp messages and search personal WhatsApp conversation history and contacts.
candidates.input_contract: contact/group name or jid and message/media
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot link to a personal WhatsApp account or read its local message store.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds whatsmeow-based personal-account send/search/media with local SQLite storage.
candidates.verify_note: MIT confirmed via WebFetch; repo warns of prompt-injection/exfiltration risk — flag for safety review.

candidates.intent: Manage WhatsApp Business templates and send messages via the Meta Cloud API.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate to the Meta Cloud API or send approved template messages.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds WhatsApp Business template management and sending over the official Cloud API.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; uses Meta Cloud API (official business channel).

candidates.intent: Send WhatsApp messages with fuzzy contact-name matching and full-text conversation search.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot resolve a fuzzy contact name against a real address book or transmit the message.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds fuzzy-name resolution, full-text search, and threaded send across WhatsApp.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; 7 tools incl. fuzzy matching and reply/threading.

candidates.intent: Expose the full Twilio API (SMS, voice, and other services) as MCP tools generated from the OpenAPI spec.
candidates.input_contract: Twilio account auth plus API operation
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate to Twilio or invoke its messaging/voice endpoints itself.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the official Twilio Labs server exposing 1,400+ endpoints with --services/--tags filtering.
candidates.verify_note: Official (Twilio Labs); MIT confirmed via WebFetch; alpha, single-user, no multi-user auth yet.

candidates.intent: Send an SMS/MMS message via the Twilio Messaging API.
candidates.input_contract: from/to numbers and message body (optional media)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot place an outbound SMS or hold Twilio credentials on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a focused Twilio Messaging API send tool with resources and prompts.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; SMS-focused single-purpose server.

candidates.intent: Send/receive SMS with automatic conversation threading and webhook-based inbound handling.
candidates.input_contract: recipient number and message; inbound webhook events
candidates.output_contract: threaded conversation state and message status
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Two-way SMS threading and inbound webhook state are stateful operations beyond a model.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds threaded SMS send/receive, MMS, and conversation management over Twilio.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; adds inbound webhook + threading over base SMS.

candidates.intent: Place voice calls and send SMS (with speech-to-text/recognition) via the Vonage API.
candidates.output_contract: call/message status and any STT result
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot originate a phone call or SMS or run telephony STT on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Vonage voice-call, SMS, speech-to-text, and speech-recognition tools.
candidates.verify_note: Vonage-Community org repo; license not stated on listing.

candidates.intent: Generate spoken audio from text via the ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech API.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model emits text but cannot synthesize an audio waveform of speech.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the official ElevenLabs TTS, voice cloning, and audio-processing tools.
candidates.verify_note: Official vendor server; license not confirmed on listing (verify SPDX in repo). Voice synthesis is model-bound.

candidates.intent: Transcribe audio to text using the ElevenLabs Scribe speech-to-text model.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot ingest raw audio or perform acoustic transcription unaided.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds official speech-to-text transcription and voice isolation.
candidates.verify_note: License not confirmed; transcription quality is model-bound.

candidates.intent: Create a Google Calendar event with attendees, Meet link, and recurrence.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate to a calendar or persist a real, conflict-aware event.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds authenticated event create/update/delete with recurring-event handling.
candidates.verify_note: MIT confirmed via WebFetch; multi-account and multi-calendar support.

candidates.intent: Check free/busy availability across one or more (incl. external) Google calendars.
candidates.input_contract: calendar ids and a time window
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model has no access to live calendar state and cannot compute real availability.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic get-freebusy query across multiple/external calendars.
candidates.verify_note: MIT confirmed via WebFetch (get-freebusy tool).

candidates.intent: Find mutual free slots and schedule a meeting with a Meet link and invites.
candidates.output_contract: scheduled event with Meet link and invites sent
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Mutual-availability solving plus invite dispatch requires live calendar access a model lacks.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds free-slot finding, event creation with Meet links, and invite sending.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo listing.

candidates.intent: Create bookings and manage event types/schedules/slots via the official Cal.com API v2.
candidates.input_contract: event type, time slot, attendee details
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate to Cal.com or write a real, conflict-checked booking.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds the official Cal.com MCP server (34 tools) for bookings, event types, and slots.
candidates.verify_note: Official Cal.com server confirmed via search (calcom/cal-mcp, 34 tools); license not confirmed on listing.

candidates.intent: Query Cal.com availability slots, schedules, and out-of-office windows.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Live availability and OOO state are account-specific and absent from model weights.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds 24 Cal.com API v2 tools for slots, schedules, calendars, and out-of-office.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; 24-tool Cal.com/Cal.eu v2 coverage.

candidates.intent: Manage Calendly events, invitees, and scheduling via natural language.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reach a Calendly account's live events or invitee state.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Calendly API access for event listing, invitees, and scheduling management.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; connects Claude to Calendly for NL scheduling.

candidates.intent: Full Calendly API coverage (auth, scheduling, availability, webhooks, routing forms, groups) as CLI+MCP.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot drive the full Calendly v2 surface (webhooks, routing forms, compliance) on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds 40 agent-native Calendly tools spanning the full API including webhooks and routing.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; 40-tool agent-native CLI + MCP server.

candidates.intent: Plan a day by combining Google Calendar events and Google Tasks.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot read live calendar/task state or write back a coordinated plan.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds combined Calendar+Tasks access so planning is grounded in real commitments.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; calendar/task writes are deterministic, the planning step is model-assisted.

candidates.intent: Read calendar events and schedule new ones in Outlook/Microsoft 365 via Graph.
candidates.output_contract: calendar event records or created event
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot reach Microsoft 365 calendar state or write events over Graph.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Graph-backed calendar read and event creation alongside mail.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; integrates calendar + mail over Microsoft Graph.

candidates.intent: Operate Outlook mail, Calendar, OneDrive, and Contacts via a minimal Microsoft Graph toolkit.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate to or operate the Microsoft Graph surface on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a compact Graph toolkit spanning Outlook, Calendar, OneDrive, and Contacts.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo listing.

candidates.intent: Send, manage, and replay ntfy push notifications to phones/desktops.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot publish to a pub/sub push service or manage notification lifecycle.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds publish/manage/fetch over the ntfy push service via STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; 4 tools over the ntfy publish/subscribe surface.

candidates.intent: Send a push notification to a device via the Pushover.net API.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot call the Pushover API or deliver a device push on its own.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic Pushover notification sender for AI agents.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated on repo listing.

candidates.intent: Send a notification across 80+ services (Discord/Telegram/Slack/Pushbullet/email/etc) via Apprise.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot fan out a single notification across many heterogeneous services.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an Apprise-backed cross-platform notification dispatch from one call.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; wraps the Apprise library (caronc/apprise) for multi-service delivery.

candidates.intent: Read and post messages and operate channels across a Mattermost workspace.
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot authenticate to a Mattermost server or post into its channels.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Mattermost API access so the agent reads and posts workspace messages.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; enables Claude to interact with Mattermost workspaces.

candidates.intent: Inspect Matrix rooms, users, state, and timelines and send chat messages on an account's behalf.
candidates.input_contract: Matrix account auth plus room/message target
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot connect to a Matrix homeserver or read/write its rooms.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Matrix room/message/user inspection and chat send over a standardized interface.
candidates.verify_note: License not stated; TypeScript Matrix homeserver integration.
